column3: S0 Walking skeleton
column4:
Prove the whole delivery path with the smallest possible feature: a page served by CloudFront calls the API, which reads the database, deployed to dev and prod by one pipeline.

Demo: Open the dev and prod URLs: the Status page shows the API version and database check. Break a lint rule, a test or a migration on purpose: the pipeline stops before prod and an email arrives.

column3: S1 Secure sign-in
column4:
Invite-only Google sign-in with roles, the first admin, and the authorization framework every later slice uses.

Demo: An invited Google account signs in and sees its name and role-based navigation; an uninvited account is refused; a deactivated account is refused.

column3: S2 Log hours
column4:
The core product for one user: log sessions with start and end times, save clients, and browse them in the entries table.

Demo: Sign in, add clients, log entries (including an overlap attempt that is blocked), sort, filter, edit, delete.

column3: S3 Goals and progress
column4:
Goal cards with ruler-style progress bars, editable targets, and the approved/pending/rejected rules.

Demo: Goal bars reflect logged hours; changing a target updates the bar; pending hours show as a lighter segment.

column3: S4 Import and export
column4:
Bring in the prototype ledger (marked Needs time) and take data out as Markdown, CSV and PDF.

Demo: Import a prototype file and see the report; export all three formats; re-import the Markdown export with identical results.

column3: S5 Organizations and admin console
column4:
Admins manage organizations, users, roles, email changes, deactivation and deletion, with an audit log.

Demo: As admin: create an organization, invite a user, grant Supervisor, change an email, deactivate and permanently delete; non-admins are refused.

column3: S6 Supervision and notifications
column4:
Find a supervisor in the same organization, request, accept or decline, end a link, and see in-app notifications.

Demo: A trainee requests a supervisor; the supervisor sees the badge, accepts; both see the right state; cross-organization attempts fail.

column3: S7 Review workflow
column4:
Approve, reject (reason), bulk approve, revert (reason), history, locking, and approved-hours-driven progress.

Demo: A supervisor approves, rejects and reverts entries; the trainee sees chips and reasons; goal bars follow approved hours.

column3: S8 Supervisor dashboard
column4:
Pick a supervisee, see per-goal progress, pending and rejected counts, and drill into entries to act.

Demo: A supervisor sees accurate summaries for accepted supervisees only and reviews from the drill-down.

column3: S9 Milestone celebrations
column4:
One-time celebration banners and confetti at 25/50/75/100% of approved hours.

Demo: Approving hours past 25% celebrates once; reload and revert-then-reapprove never replay.

column3: S10 Team schedules
column4:
Read-only Monday to Friday schedules for peers with the same supervisor, showing only time and category.

Demo: Two peers see each other's week blocks; no client, notes, hours, on-site or status ever appears; non-peers are refused.

column3: S11 Hardening and go-live
column4:
Security suites, performance, accessibility, restore drill, cost check, runbook, user guide and the production release.

Demo: All gates green on dev; runbook and user guide done; owner approves prod.
